description:
Sets or deletes a key/value tag on a run. Every message is kept as history; the
current value of a key is the one with the newest ts.

v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

id.description: Tag message ID, generated by the CLI; lets the pipeline drop duplicates from QoS 1.
id.title: Id

run.description: Run of dev the tag belongs to. May arrive before the run's start record.
run.title: Run

key.description: Tag name: lower case letters, digits and _.
key.title: Key

value.description: Tag value; null deletes the tag.
value.title: Value

ts.description: Time on the laptop, Unix seconds UTC; the newest ts per key is the current value.
ts.title: Ts

title: TagMessage
